purpose: Compare original trained execution after bounding decoder concurrency; do not assume quantization improves CPU speed
runtime: Original Torch eager encoder and head; no graph conversion
conditions: AC power; two Torch threads; one OpenCV and FFmpeg decoder thread; no concurrent tests or inference
gate: All three rounds below 250ms p95, all four controls correct, all 138 timestamps and flags unchanged, maximum score difference <= 1e-4
limits: Reused controls; no threshold tuning. Original INT8 and FP32 failures remain recorded. An application load test is still required even if these checks pass.
